scope: Direct imports of exact OpenCode collector source; genuine Node crypto, synthetic data only. No SDK/provider/model, user data, real tool execution or network.
also_checked: Ordinary and changing type getters maintain read count/order and keep thrown error sticky
Mixed kinds/IDs, earlier blocks, authoritative end, metadata, tool name/input and usage/finish order
Sticky malformed/tool/provider errors, premature EOF and rejected post-finish events
compatibility_scope: Native built-in Array.prototype.includes; test observer forwards without mutation. No guarantee for code that replaces Array methods and mutates their receivers.
